summary.description: What was changed and why, in two sentences or less.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths actually created or modified.

verification.description: The exact command run to verify the work and its result, or 'none' if nothing was run.

confidence.description: low if the prompt was ambiguous or the work is unverified.

concerns.description: Anything the reviewer should look at closely. Empty array if none.
